name: android-cook
description: End-to-end Android task orchestrator. The dmb-android-cook skill clarifies requirements via targeted Q&A, breaks work into testable subtasks, then drives a sequential dev->build->test->fix loop using the dmb-android-dev and dmb-android-qa subagents until every subtask passes on a real device. Bundles Clean Architecture, module-creation, and platform-component skills, plus the mobile-mcp server for device QA.
